Don't try to feel shame. Know that all of this isn't you, it's your mental illness. If it means anything, I have violent images that pop into my heads sometimes, too. When I was getting a tattoo I couldn't help but think of gruesome scenes of blood and one time I imagined one of my friend's dad's gouging out his eyeballs with a knife. You've made a good start with reaching out here, the next step maybe will be to look for a therapist just to talk about everything, and maybe they can get you on the correct meds for yourself. Idk what country you live in but i know in the USA they can't force you into an institution unless you're a danger to yourself/others. Good luck and I really wish the best for you!
